=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:153-154 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When several alerts are queued and the `delivered` count goes up, the code saves the day marker even if not all alerts were delivered (`delivered < attempted`).
  WHY: If the first alert is delivered but later ones fail, `alerted=true` is written to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` and the day marker is saved, so later runs on the same day do not retry the failed alerts. The source severity was MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash stated in narration that the marker is only written when `delivered > 0` (scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:204-213) and raised no finding.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:line 199 (`msg_id="$(tg_send_msg "${msg}" WARNING)"`) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: None. The reviewer verified that removing `2>/dev/null` is safe, because `tg_send_msg` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:129-161) writes only fixed text or Telegram's sanitized `.description` to stderr.
  WHY: It does not fail. The bot token is only in the curl URL, and curl's own stderr is already discarded (tg_helpers.sh:150). The source severity was NIT.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:lines 148-153 (counts-parse warning) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: None. The new warning text matches the real control flow: when jq fails, `counts=""`, `alert_count=0`, the send loop is skipped and no day marker is written.
  WHY: It does not fail. Behaviour is unchanged and only the old warning text was misleading. The source severity was NIT.
- tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:lines 28-31 (regex patterns with `\s*`) and lines 60-71 (full-text scan with comment lines stripped) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: None. The regex changes keep the earlier matches, add multi-line matches, and correctly exclude whole-line `#` comments.
  WHY: It does not fail. The synthetic test asserts that `MULTI_LINE_STAGE_ENABLED` is detected and that `COMMENTED_ENABLED` and `OPT_IN_ENABLED` are excluded. The source severity was NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  EVIDENCE: The `off_on_purpose` structure and its handling are present, but `tests/test_stage_switch_watch.py` has no explicit test that an expired marker switches back to alerting. Only the marker's validity is tested.
- requirement: "The registry test fails when a workflow gains a `vars.<NAME>_ENABLED || 'true'` expression that the registry does not list."
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py`, `_workflow_true_switches`

  EVIDENCE: The workflow scan at lines 62-62 uses `workflows_dir.glob("*.yml")`, so `.yaml` workflows are not scanned. An unregistered default-on switch added only to such a workflow would not be detected.
